about: The flows built by recipe from the record (tools/flows-build.mjs; recipes in app/flows/core.js). One line each: kind (wake, handover, night, hour: the last hour of the record), agent (its role or full name), and optionally n (the session handing over), at (a UTC time inside the wake), title, summary. incident.storyteller@'s paths in story/paths/*.md are added on their own.
